title: Repair-History Discount on In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Sales
content:
# Repair-History Discount on In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Sales

**Discount note.** When a patient buys outright the PAP Therapy Equipment unit that stands in their home, the unit is discounted by the repair jobs on its device record, counting every repair job on that record including jobs on a unit since swapped out:

| Repair jobs on the device record | Discount |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10 percent |
| exactly one | 5 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Where it is read.** Every repair job in the device's service history counts, whoever bore its cost and whichever serial it was done on.

**How the percentage acts.** The discount is a percentage of the unit's price as it stands before percentage discounts. Where the sale carries more than one percentage discount, the percentages are first added into one total percentage, which reduces that price once, rounded half up to the cent; the percentages never act one after the other.

**Worked figure (hypothetical price of 854.05).** One repair job: 5 percent; 854.05 multiplied by 0.95 is 811.3475, rounded half up to 811.35.
